svg.title: One benchmark run
svg.desc: A benchmark run takes 50 WebQSP questions with their right answers, loads each question's graph into Neo4j, walks each question with a decision model or an LLM that gets the same options, scores each answer with WebQSP's own scoring, and adds up the scores and costs.
svg.text: d1-ultra on 50 WebQSP questions. The pictures follow one of them, from the question to its score.
one line per question, with its score, cost and decisions
Every model walks the same questions with the same options, and every answer is scored the same way.
